description: DESTRUCTIVE: undo the player's newest change to the collection, whoever made it (the web app, you, another assistant, a key), within the last 24 hours; call again to step further back. Without confirm:true this is a dry run: it says what would be undone (`change`), who made it (`made_by`; `yours` is false when it was not you: tell the player), and `removes_copies`, the copies the undo takes out of the collection (an import's cards): say the count. Then repeat with confirm:true and the dry run's op_id and copies, once the player agrees. A swap is never undone (propose a new one), and an undo is refused when the cards changed since or a deck was deleted: relay the refusal, which says what to do instead.

copies.description: The dry run's copies: refused if that change grew since (an import resumed)

op_id.description: The dry run's op_id: refused if a newer change came since
